mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transcript WHERE path_sha256 = UNHEX(SHA2(#{path}, 256)) AND path = #{path}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transcript(path, configured_path, canonical_path, file_key, generation, byte_offset, anchor_hash, observed_size, modified_at, scanned_at) VALUES(#{path}, #{path}, #{path}, #{fileKey}, #{generation}, #{byteOffset}, #{anchorHash}, #{observedSize}, #{modifiedAt}, #{scannedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transcript ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transcript_item
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_raw_hook_event(delivery_id, observed_at, received_at, forwarder_version, raw_json, parse_status, error_code) VALUES(#{deliveryId}, #{observedAt}, #{receivedAt}, #{forwarderVersion}, #{rawJson}, #{parseStatus}, #{errorCode})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM execution_raw_hook_event WHERE delivery_id_sha256 = UNHEX(SHA2(#{deliveryId}, 256)) AND delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_normalization_job(source_kind, source_id, status, attempts, available_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{sourceKind}, #{sourceId}, 'PENDING', 0, #{now}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_normalization_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_raw_hook_event
mapper.update: UPDATE execution_normalization_job SET status='RUNNING', attempts=attempts+1, updated_at=#{now}, error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE execution_normalization_job SET status='COMPLETED', updated_at=#{now}, error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE execution_normalization_job SET status='FAILED', updated_at=#{now}, error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM execution_raw_hook_event WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_session(session_id, transcript_path, started_at, ended_at, state, last_observed_at, version) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{transcriptPath}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{state}, #{lastObservedAt}, #{revision})

INSERT INTO execution_turn(session_id, turn_id, title, model, working_directory, started_at, ended_at, state, version) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{title}, #{model}, #{workingDirectory}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{state}, #{revision})

INSERT INTO execution_tool_call(session_id, turn_id, tool_use_id, tool_name, pre_observed_at, post_observed_at, state, estimated_duration_ms, duration_valid, version) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{toolUseId}, #{toolName}, #{preObservedAt}, #{postObservedAt}, #{state}, #{estimatedDurationMs}, #{durationValid}, #{revision})

INSERT INTO execution_change(aggregate_type, session_id, turn_id, tool_use_id, aggregate_revision, change_kind, changed_at) VALUES(#{aggregateType}, #{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{toolUseId}, #{aggregateRevision}, 'STATE_RECORDED', COALESCE(#{changedAt}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE execution_raw_hook_event SET parse_status=#{status}, error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM execution_session WHERE session_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{sessionId}, 256)) AND session_id=#{sessionId}
SELECT * FROM execution_turn WHERE session_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{sessionId}, 256)) AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND turn_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{turnId}, 256)) AND turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT * FROM execution_tool_call WHERE session_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{sessionId}, 256)) AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND turn_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{turnId}, 256)) AND tool_use_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{toolUseId}, 256)) AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND tool_use_id=#{toolUseId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_turn t
WHERE lower(t.session_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', lower(#{query}), '%') OR lower(t.turn_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', lower(#{query}), '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_record(batch_id, object_index, signal_type, trace_id, span_id, turn_id, call_id, object_kind, duration_ms, event_time, received_at, raw_json, parse_status) VALUES(#{batchId}, #{objectIndex}, #{signalType}, #{traceId}, #{spanId}, #{turnId}, #{callId}, #{objectKind}, #{durationMs}, #{eventTime}, #{receivedAt}, #{rawJson}, #{parseStatus}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=telemetry_record.id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telemetry_record WHERE signal_type=#{signalType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transcript_unknown_fingerprint(fingerprint_sha256,canonical_shape,source_kind,first_seen_at,last_seen_at,occurrence_count,mapping_status) VALUES(#{sha},#{shape},'JSONL',#{now},#{now},0,'UNMAPPED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fingerprint_sha256=fingerprint_sha256
mapper.update: UPDATE transcript_unknown_fingerprint SET last_seen_at=#{now}, occurrence_count=occurrence_count+1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM transcript_unknown_fingerprint WHERE fingerprint_sha256=#{sha}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transcript_unknown_item(fingerprint_id,transcript_item_id) VALUES(#{fingerprintId},#{rawRecordId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE transcript_item_id=transcript_unknown_item.transcript_item_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transcript_unknown_fingerprint ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transcript_unknown_fingerprint
SELECT * FROM transcript_unknown_fingerprint WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT r.id, r.transcript_id source_id, r.generation, r.byte_offset, r.end_offset, r.content_hash, r.raw_bytes, r.raw_text, r.parse_status, r.item_type event_type, r.event_time, r.ingested_at FROM transcript_item r JOIN transcript_unknown_item u ON u.transcript_item_id=r.id WHERE u.fingerprint_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version),0)+1 FROM transcript_unknown_mapping WHERE fingerprint_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE transcript_unknown_fingerprint SET mapping_status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trace_transcript_evidence_link( transcript_item_id,target_type,session_id,turn_id,tool_use_id,content_kind,call_id, level,evidence_json,algorithm_version,content_text) SELECT #{rawRecordId}, 'TURN', t.session_id, t.turn_id, NULL, #{contentKind}, #{callId}, #{mappingLevel}, #{evidenceJson}, #{adapterVersion}, #{contentText} FROM execution_turn t WHERE #{nodeType}='TURN' AND t.turn_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{nodeId}, 256)) AND t.turn_id=#{nodeId} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_turn candidate WHERE candidate.turn_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{nodeId}, 256)) AND candidate.turn_id=#{nodeId})=1 UNION ALL SELECT #{rawRecordId}, 'TOOL_CALL', c.session_id, c.turn_id, c.tool_use_id, #{contentKind}, #{callId}, #{mappingLevel}, #{evidenceJson}, #{adapterVersion}, #{contentText} FROM execution_tool_call c WHERE #{nodeType}='TOOL' AND c.tool_use_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{nodeId}, 256)) AND c.tool_use_id=#{nodeId} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_tool_call candidate WHERE candidate.tool_use_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{nodeId}, 256)) AND candidate.tool_use_id=#{nodeId})=1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=trace_transcript_evidence_link.id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transcript_unknown_mapping WHERE fingerprint_id=#{id} AND status='VALID' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.transcript_id source_id, r.generation, r.byte_offset, r.end_offset, r.content_hash, r.raw_bytes, r.raw_text, r.parse_status, r.item_type event_type, r.event_time, r.ingested_at FROM transcript_item r JOIN transcript_unknown_item u ON u.transcript_item_id=r.id WHERE u.fingerprint_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.id
